name: brisa-native
description: Cascarón nativo (Capacitor) de Brisa para iOS y Android. Las plataformas se generan en CI.

scripts.platform:android: npx cap add android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --assetPath resources --iconBackgroundColor '#1b2140' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#1b2140' --splashBackgroundColor '#1b2140' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#1b2140' && node scripts/patch-platforms.mjs android && npx cap sync android
scripts.platform:ios: npx cap add ios && npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios --assetPath resources --iconBackgroundColor '#1b2140' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#1b2140' --splashBackgroundColor '#1b2140' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#1b2140' && node scripts/patch-platforms.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios
